problem: The first speech implementation concluded no Macedonian TTS existed and shipped a Bulgarian Piper voice driven by espeak-ng's Macedonian front end as the local option, with Microsoft's mk-MK-AleksandarNeural over the network as the default. The user rejected both premises: they refused the Bulgarian stand-in outright ('нејќам на бугарски') and insisted a real Macedonian voice existed and the search had been too shallow. They were right.
change: Searched again and harder, including a delegated exhaustive survey. Confirmed no NEURAL model trained on Macedonian exists (Piper 177 voices/58 languages, Meta MMS-TTS 1143 languages from its own file manifest, XTTS-v2, Kokoro, Coqui zoo, sherpa-onnx, HF model/space search). Found RHVoice: HTS parametric, written for blind users, packaged in Ubuntu multiverse as rhvoice-macedonian, carrying two voices recorded from Macedonian speakers — Kiko (male, Government of North Macedonia, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and Suze (female, FEEIT UKIM Skopje with UNICEF, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Added aries/speech/rhvoice.py: ctypes over the system libRHVoice.so.5 with dependencies dlopen'd RTLD_GLOBAL rather than via LD_LIBRARY_PATH, since the voice daemon's wrapper already owns that variable. Added scripts/aries-fetch-rhvoice for a rootless install by apt-get download plus dpkg-deb -x. Made Kiko the Macedonian default, Microsoft the fallback for a machine without RHVoice, and removed the Bulgarian voice entirely: model deleted from disk and Piper now raises by name if asked for Macedonian.
validation: Measured on this machine. Kiko: engine init 1.1 ms, +1.8 MB RSS, 68 ms median to first sound over seven sentences, RTF 0.024, 24 kHz, fully offline. Whisper large-v3 round-trip mean WER 0.387 — better than Microsoft's 0.421 (410-1600 ms, network) and far better than the refused Piper-Bulgarian 0.578 and espeak-ng 0.863. Both voices enumerate as language 'mk' through the C API. Fallback chain verified by emptying the RHVoice search path: Macedonian fell through to Microsoft and reported fell_back_from honestly. Rootless extraction verified before the system package existed: apt-get download plus dpkg-deb -x produced working synthesis with no root, since there is no C++ toolchain on this machine to build from source. tests/test_speech.py 46 checks; ./scripts/test.sh ALL SUITES PASSED. Voice chosen by the user listening: 'гласот Kiko земи го'.
limitations: Both RHVoice voices are NonCommercial and Suze is additionally NoDerivatives, so this is fine for a personal assistant and a blocker for anything sold or fine-tuned. HTS parametric synthesis is audibly a synthesizer; Microsoft is more natural and remains one environment variable away. The WER figure is a machine proxy for a listener and is inflated equally for every engine by Whisper writing digits where the text has number words. No test plays audio, so playback itself has no regression guard. speak() has not run inside the live aries-voice.service process, though pw-play was verified from a systemd user unit and the module was verified to load alongside faster_whisper under the wrapper's LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The licence-clean long-term answer — a Piper mk_MK voice trained on the 24 CC0 hours in Common Voice mk — does not exist yet and nobody has attempted it.
